text_simplified:
Parents have a profound influence on their children's upbringing because they are their primary role models whose example children follow.
This responsibility is especially great in our time, when temptations, distractions, and harmful influences have multiplied and now enter children's homes and bedrooms through various devices and media.
This confirms the necessity of attending to the correct pillars of child upbringing.
